pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with rounded vertices. Edges show a gradual pixel gradient from dark centers to lighter peripheries. Patch size is largest on the upper shoulder, becoming smaller and more elongated along the lower neck area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways separating the patches. Features primarily three-way junctions forming a honeycomb-like topological graph. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform but decreases slightly at the junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A dark, fibrous mane is visible along the dorsal neck, exhibiting a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated edge against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Visual continuity of the mane is interrupted by the presence of a perched bird on the upper neck and by a dark synthetic band near the base of the neck.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark tracking collar is visible around the lower neck. A small bird is perched on the dorsal ridge near the junction of the neck and shoulder.
